detailed_findings_md:
- **ARCH-001** (Important, rule RULE-ADR-CODE, ADR-SAG-0013/0008/0031/0016): `docs/architecture.md:856` (and 254-266, 1754-1756, ADR-SAG-0016 r-6 amendment). Four delta behaviours live only in the sprint doc and crate docs: envelope correlation_id = session id and request_id = answer id with Warn on failed send; the FileSessionStore::new sweep at TTL + 1 TTL grace; the error-path flush note; and the ADR-SAG-0016 id mapping. Remediation: add one bullet per ADR amendment in this PR, or in a later ADR amendment before the next sprint depends on them.
- **QA-001** (Minor, rust-qa): `crates/sc-jev-host/src/obs.rs:198`. RSH-003 and RSH-004 have no test coverage. Nothing asserts the envelope correlation_id/request_id or the Warn/Info level, and the parse path uses `.ok()`. Remediation: in `crates/sc-jev-host/tests/log_context.rs`, assert level, correlation_id and request_id for the failed row (Warn, via the existing test_error_path_flushes_the_failed_row) and the ok row (Info).
- **FTQ-005** (Minor, flaky-test-qa, mechanism unbounded_wait): `crates/sc-jev-check/tests/session.rs:467` in test_two_stores_same_dir_last_writer_wins. The writer join has no deadline. Remediation: send a completion message per writer over an mpsc channel and wait with recv_timeout (about 30 s), panicking with the stuck writer index.
- **FTQ-006** (Minor, flaky-test-qa, mechanism unbounded_wait): `crates/sc-ai/tests/cli.rs:379` in test_cli_log_flush_warning_in_data. The mkfifo spawn uses Command::status with no deadline. Remediation: run it through `deadline::spawn_with_deadline(..., None)` and assert status.success().
next_action: triage_and_fix: fix or resolve ARCH-001, QA-001, FTQ-005, FTQ-006, then re-QA. Wait for CI test (windows-2022) to finish green.
